label: dome_coast_square_npc_01
text: Lacey’s really nice! She’ll teach you all about\nPokémon and make it easy to understand!

label: dome_coast_square_npc_02
text: Lacey washes her Pokémon three times per day\nso they’re always fresh and clean.

label: dome_coast_square_npc_12
text: Sure, Dragon types are strong—but to Fairy\ntypes, they’re no sweat!

label: dome_coast_square_npc_13
text: I hear Lacey’s never been able to beat Drayton,\neven though her Pokémon should have a type\r\nadvantage over his.

label: dome_coast_beach_npc_12
text: The ocean is the true star of the Coastal Biome!\nIt’s real seawater, you know!

label: dome_coast_area3_npc_03
text: There are vending machines at the rest areas in\nthe Terarium! They sell all kinds of Poké Balls!

label: dome_coast_area3_npc_04
text: Dive Balls will give you a better chance of\ncatching Pokémon that are swimming.

label: dome_savanna_square_npc_01
text: If you see a little structure made of blocks, that’s\na rest area. Big structures like this one are plazas!

label: dome_savanna_square_npc_02
text: You should watch Crispin cook—it’s amazing!\nHe uses Magmortar’s flames to roast everything!

label: dome_savanna_square_npc_04
text: Fire-type Pokémon can’t get burned! Knowing\nthat can open up some options!

label: dome_savanna_battlecourt_npc_03
text:
I love the Savanna Biome ’cause it’s where you
can find Blitzle—and Blitzle’s the greatest!\c
You’ll find different Pokémon if you cross over
into one of the other biomes!

label: dome_savanna_battlecourt_npc_05
text: You can face members of the Elite Four on the\nbattle court at their plazas!

label: dome_savanna_battlecourt_npc_06
text: Students can’t even challenge the Elite Four until\nthey’re a high enough rank in the BB League.

label: dome_savanna_area3_npc_01
text: Trapinch gains the Dragon type when it evolves.\nIsn’t that weird? I wonder why.

label: dome_savanna_area3_npc_03
text: It makes me all nervous if someone stands behind\nme while I’m using a self-serve healing machine!

label: dome_canyon_square_npc_01
text: Amarys is so cool! So impressive! She’s president\nof the student council AND one of the Elite Four!

label: dome_canyon_square_npc_02
text:
In the Canyon Biome you can find lots of rugged
Pokémon!\c
That includes the Steel types that Amarys uses.
She’s this area’s Elite Four rep!

label: dome_canyon_square_npc_03
text:
Skarmory are some tough Pokémon. Not many
types can get through their defenses!\c
They really pull their weight—and ours—around
here, since they fly the Terarium’s Flying Taxis!

label: dome_canyon_area2_npc_04
text: Apparently, there’s a Pokémon in some region\nthat’s Corviknight’s natural predator.\c\nImagine how terrifying it must look!

label: dome_canyon_area2_npc_05
text: My boyfriend and I got to know each other by\nbonding over how much we love Corviknight!

label: dome_canyon_area2_npc_07
text: I guess it’d be reckless and irresponsible to try\nthe Flying Time Trial on Trumbeak, huh...

label: dome_canyon_area4_npc_07
text: This here is Chargestone Cavern! Watch out, or\nyou’ll get zapped!

label: dome_polar_square_npc_02
text: Drayton’s in his second year, right? But I could’ve\nsworn he was a second-year last year too.\r\nAnd I think even the year before that...

label: dome_polar_area2_npc_01
text: The Polar Biome’s where Pokémon live if they’re\nreally good at handling the cold. It’s got a few\r\nmore Ice types than other biomes!

label: dome_center_square_npc_01
text: The Canyon Biome’s through here! There’s a lot\nof rough, rocky surfaces, so you might want to\r\nride on a Pokémon.

label: dome_center_square_npc_05
text: I heard I can get more rewards from BBQs if I do\n’em with friends! Guess I just need some friends.

label: dome_center_square_npc_07
text: Welcome to the Central Plaza, where the four\nbiomes meet!

label: dome_center_square_npc_14_01
text: The vibes around the League Club have been off\nlately, don’t you think?

label: dome_center_square_npc_15_01
text: The League Club used to be really fun. Not so\nmuch since Kieran beat Drayton and became\r\nChampion, though.

label: dome_center_square_npc_14_02
text: Not to be mean or anything, but I’m glad\nKieran’s not Champion anymore. I’d been hoping\r\nhe’d step down, one way or another.

label: dome_center_square_npc_15_02
text: I heard the new Champion isn’t even from our\nschool!

label: dome_center_square_npc_14_03
text: I’m so glad the League Club’s back to how it\nused to be! Battling each other is fun again!

label: dome_center_square_npc_15_03
text: The League Club’s way more fun now. I feel like I\ncan really give my best! I might even aim to join\r\nthe Elite Four or something!

label: dome_center_square_npc_16
text:
The blocks you see around the Terarium give off
infrared and ultraviolet rays!\c
Apparently those rays help Pokémon and plants
grow!

label: dome_center_square_npc_21
text: Through here is the Polar Biome! It’s reeeally\ncold ’cause there are artificially-made glaciers.

label: dome_center_square_npc_35
text: Quests involving Tera Raid Battles are waaay\neasier if you do ’em together!

label: dome_center_square_npc_36
text: Me an’ my big brother do BBQs together!

label: dome_center_square_npc_40_01
text: That first-year, Kieran... It’s like he’s turned into a\ncompletely different person all of a sudden.

label: dome_center_square_npc_40_02
text: That Championship battle was something else!\nKieran seemed really upset afterward...

label: dome_center_square_npc_40_03
text: I heard Kieran’s taking some time off school.\nReally hope he gets better soon.

label: dome_center_square_npc_48
text: Only outstanding students get Tera Orbs! The\norbs are made out of some kind of really\r\nprecious material, they say...

label: dome_center_square_npc_49
text: There’s so much to think about with Terastallizing!\nSometimes it makes your Pokémon weak to more\r\ntypes than before!

label: dome_center_square_npc_50
text: The Coastal Biome’s past here! The flowers, the\nsea...it’s all Alola’d up!

label: dome_center_square_npc_54
text: Wait a sec. Do these blocks come in different\ncolors for the different biomes?

label: dome_center_square_npc_56
text: There was a TM on the blocks behind me. Did\nyou pick it up already?

label: dome_center_square_npc_57_01
text: I’ve heard things are strained between the\nLeague Club kids. Being a teacher, I can’t\r\nhelp but worry about them...

label: dome_center_square_npc_57_02
text: I’ve heard things have settled down between the\nLeague Club kids. Being a teacher, I wish I could\r\nhave done more to help...

label: dome_center_square_npc_57_03
text: I’ve heard things are better between the\nLeague Club kids again. Being a teacher, I\r\njust hope I can help keep them smiling.

label: dome_canyon_square_npc_11
text: Have you ever tried the Flying Time Trial?\nMagneton helps out on the course!
